newsitem.title: INDIA: Voltas unit wins India TELCO order.
newsitem.headline: Voltas unit wins India TELCO order.

text.p: Airconditioner maker Voltas-AIG Ltd said it was selected by Indian automobile firm Tata Engineering and Locomotive Company Ltd (TELCO) as a major supplier of airconditioners for its proposed small car.

"The assignment involves designing, engineering, testing and manufacture of car air conditioning," Voltas said in a statement. Voltas-AIG is a joint venture between Voltas Ltd and Air International Group of Australia.
"Voltas-AIG bagged this order against stiff competition from both Indian and international companies," it said.
TELCO, India's largest truck maker, plans to roll out its small car in the second quarter of 1998/99 (April-March).
The car is expected to compete with market leader Maruti, the small car manufactured by Maruti Udyog Ltd, a joint venture between Suzuki Motor Corp of Japan and the Indian government.
